title: Microsoft Purview: Microsoft Graph APIs for archive mailboxes as EWS retires (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says Microsoft has not documented how GCC maps to the Graph cloud columns. Microsoft's national cloud documentation explicitly places GCC on the worldwide endpoint and identifies the separate GCC High and DoD endpoints; this does not establish feature-specific GCC rollout timing. The roadmap details, cited controls and other checked statements are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Graph access to main and auxiliary archive mailboxes.
claims.quote: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph.

claims.claim: The roadmap's goal is a single archive view across physically distributed auxiliary mailboxes as EWS is deprecated.
claims.quote: The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes with EWS Graph APIs being deprecated.

claims.claim: Access to an auxiliary archive folder can return HTTP 308, and the app follows the response URL.
claims.quote: If the target resides in an auxiliary archive, the API returns a redirect response (such as HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect) with a redirect URL. Your app makes a new request to the URL indicated in the response.

claims.claim: Export can return ErrorArchiveFolderMovedPermanently, requiring a new export request to the supplied URL.
claims.quote: some items in the response might include an ErrorArchiveFolderMovedPermanently error instead of data. This indicates that the item physically resides in an auxiliary archive mailbox. Reissue the export request for those items using the URL provided in the error message.
